items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: I’m not too familiar with them, Dianne Reeves, and Krall?

ctx.x: That’s my sister-in-law. She’s just new recording, and she’s been singing a long time, but they’re just beginning to hear her, but she’s a very wonderful singer. So I like her. And there’s a young lady, her name is Denia, Denia Green. But I don’t know if she’s recorded yet or not, but she’s very good. I know you’re speaking of probably you’re speaking of Dianne Reeves, and I’m not too familiar with them, Dianne Reeves, and Krall?
